description: Set IPTC text from get_photo_metadata. Omitted fields stay, empty strings clear. Copyright status is unwritable. Returns updated (photos written) and fields; unknown IDs are not_found. Rules: give at least one of title, caption, headline, creator, copyright, rights_usage_terms, copyright_info_url, creator_url, alt_text, extended_description.

copyright_info_url.description: Copyright info URL, e.g. a licensing page

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths
